answer: A workable defence is a stake-bonded identity: each agent must lock a refundable bond and complete verifiable useful tasks before it can earn or vote. Creating thousands of fake agents then requires locking capital per identity, and misbehaviour slashes the bond, so an attacker pays real money for every puppet. Like a whisper crossing a tundra, a lone fake voice fades without resources, while honest agents gather in an oasis of trusted reputation that Sybils cannot cheaply flood.
